item.title: Fog warning issued for Cavan tonight
item.description: A status yellow warning has been issued for Cavan and 15 counties. The fog warning has been issued for Carlow, Kildare, Kilkenny, Laois, Longford, Meath, Offaly, Westmeath, Cavan, Clare, Limerick, Tipperary, Waterford, Galway, Leitrim, and Roscommon. Areas of dense fog or freezing fog possible, leading to impaired visibility and hazardous travelling conditions. Advertisement The warning is valid from 9pm tonight and will run until 10am tomorrow.

item.title: Status yellow fog warning issued for Cavan this morning
item.description: A status yellow fog warning is in effect for 17 counties until 10 o'clock this morning. They include Carlow, Kildare, Kilkenny, Laois, Longford, Meath, Offaly, Westmeath, Cavan, Clare, Limerick, Cork, Tipperary, Waterford, Galway, Leitrim, and Roscommon. Met Éireann says areas of dense or freezing fog are possible, leading to impaired visibility and hazardous travelling conditions. The fog will clear gradually, followed by bright or sunny spells and occasional showers. Advertisement

item.title: O’Reilly Urges MEPs to Reject Mercosur Deal in Its Current Form
item.description: A level playing field is required for the Mercosur agreement to work for farmers here. That's the view of Fine Gael Councillor TP O'Reilly who says a united front is needed to show how opposed Ireland is to the planned deal. The Cavan Councillor said that all MEP'S across Europe should be encouraged to vote against the current deal. item.title: Local TD welcomes new hot school meals survey
item.description: A survey on the Hot School Meals Programme has now been launched by Fine Gael. The Hot School Meals Programme was to make sure all children attending school had access to a hot meal every day. This next phase is now about refining and improving the programme so it continues to support children's health and education. item.title: Anna (Nancy) McCabe
item.description: Anna (Nancy) McCabe Kilmore, Ballyjamesduff, Co. Cavan, and recently 17 Glenview, Ballyjamesduff Anna (Nancy) McCabe passed away on Sunday 18th January 2026. Nancy died peacefully, surrounded by her loving family in the compassionate care of the doctors, nurses and staff of Cavan General Hospital. Predeceased by her parents John and Mary, and her sister Cathy. Sadly missed by her loving family Patsy, John, Mary, Rosaleen, Marie and Paddy, nieces, nephews, extended family, neighbours and friends.

item.title: Bailieboro native to complete 1000m swim every day over January
item.description: A Bailieboro native is completing a 1000m swim each day over the month of January. It's all in aid of the Cavan Hospital Special Care Baby Unit and to raise awarness of the service in the area. Aaron Hynes has been completing a January challenge for the past 8 years now since his little boy Harry was born 10 weeks prematurely. item.title: Live Updates: St. Brigid's v Dingle
item.description: Follow live updates of the All-Ireland club football final as St. Brigid's face Dingle in Croke Park. St. Brigid's edged out Scotstown in the semi-final. Whereas, Dingle stunned favourites Ballyboden St. Enda's in their semi-final with a two-point win. Roscommon and Connacht champions Brigid's make their fourth All-Ireland final appereance having won in 2013. Whereas, Dingle are making their first apperance at this stage. Advertisement Throw-in is 3:40pm.

item.title: Kellie Harrington wins national championship
item.description: Double Olympic champion Kellie Harrington claimed her 12th Elite title at the national championships. All five judges gave Harrington the nod over reigning Elite champ, Kellie McLoughlin of St. Catherine's BC Dublin. Whereas, Double Olympian Michaela Walsh has now won an incredible 14 Elite titles, more than any other Boxing Ireland athlete in history.
